review.evidence: Reviewed 2026-10-01. At finalized Solana slot 452212758, ONYC retained its OnRe-program-owned mint authority PDA and Squads vault upgrade authority. The upgrade multisig now requires 4-of-7 signatures and a 21600-second timelock, with no external config authority; the historical July configuration was 3-of-6 without delay. ProgramData records the OnRe program's latest deployment at slot 442113459. The issuer's monthly Apex report directory now includes August 2026; the report cover identifies an unaudited agreed-upon-procedures engagement for ONyc NAV as of 2026-08-31, while publication date and detailed reconciliation scope remain unverified. The BMA registry re-opened this session names On Re SAC Ltd as a Class IIGB insurer and Class F digital-asset business, registration 55347. The mint remains program-controlled and upgradeable; no fixed economic supply bound is established by this review.
